data.narrative:
SandboxAQ is a Series E AI & Software company founded by Jack Hidary that has raised $950M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $5.75B. The peer universe comprises one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private frontier-tech firms including Applied Intuition, Wayve, and Ayar Labs at adjacent or similar stages.

Two triangulation methods apply to this valuation. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.4x multiplier to the $5.8B last post-money, implies $8.0B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Applied Intuition at $15.0B (Series F), Wayve at $8.6B (Series D), and Ayar Labs at $3.8B (Series E)—yields a median of $8.6B, with a range of $3.8B to $15.0B. Both methods cluster tightly around the $8.0B–$8.6B band.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.8B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $8.3B. This represents 44% upside from the current $5.75B. Key uncertainties center on the dispersion within the peer set—the $15.0B-to-$3.8B spread reflects material variance in investor conviction across frontier-AI stages—and the relevance of public comps given the nascent, private-market-dominated nature of this sector.
